ruling.recommended_action: Route to Ryde Trust & Safety for manual review: obtain full unthinned GPS trace and in-cabin audio/telematics if available, interview both parties, assess the driver's "I lock the doors" message under the Code of Conduct, and offer the rider welfare/support paths (RydeHELP; 995 if any injury or ongoing distress) before any fare/account action is taken.
